config.open-tracker-key.name: Open tracker key
config.open-tracker-key.tooltip: The key that opens the 999 Challenge Tracker during gameplay. Press it again (or Escape) to close.
config.ignore-quality.name: Ignore quality
config.ignore-quality.tooltip: Count an item's Have/999 at any quality instead of requiring its own highest-reachable quality (e.g. iridium-aged Wine, or iridium produce). Turn this on if you don't want to quality-grind everything.
config.exclude-legendary-roe.name: Exclude legendary fish Roe
config.exclude-legendary-roe.tooltip: Excludes Roe/Aged Roe for Crimsonfish, Angler, Legend, Glacierfish and Mutant Carp from Required/Total. Turn this on if you caught (and didn't keep) one of these before you started tracking - a Fish Pond needs a live specimen to breed from, so it can never be caught again.
config.exclude-qi-fruit-goods.name: Exclude Qi Fruit goods
config.exclude-qi-fruit-goods.tooltip: Excludes Qi Fruit Jelly, Wine and Dried Qi Fruit from Required/Total. Qi Fruit only grows from the seasonal, limited-time Qi's Crop quest beans - turn this on if you didn't stockpile 999 beans before that quest ended, since you can never make any more.
config.scan-only-dedicated-storage.name: Scan only dedicated storage
config.scan-only-dedicated-storage.toolt: If on, only your own inventory, chests/fridges inside a tagged location, and individually tagged chests count - everything else on the farm is ignored. If off (default), everything everywhere counts, same as always. Tag a location or a chest with the two keys below.
config.toggle-location-tracked-key.name: Tag current location key
config.toggle-location-tracked-key.toolt: Tags/untags your current location (e.g. a dedicated Shed) as dedicated storage - every chest and fridge inside it then counts as a whole. Only matters when 'Scan only dedicated storage' is on.
config.toggle-chest-tracked-key.name: Tag open chest key
config.toggle-chest-tracked-key.tooltip: With a chest's menu open, tags/untags that one chest as dedicated storage - for a chest outside any tagged location. Only matters when 'Scan only dedicated storage' is on.
menu.title: 999 Challenge Tracker
menu.search.no-matches: No items match - try a different search.
menu.hover.unknown: The game can't tell this apart from other sources - check manually.
